name: scholarship scheme - Uttarakhand Agricultural Production & Marketing Board, Uttarakhand
benefit: Students pursuing courses in Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries, Horticulture and other related fields at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar; R.M.P. (P.G.) College, Gurukul Narsan, Haridwar; V.C.S.G. Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry, Bharsar, Pauri Garhwal; and the College of Horticulture, V.C.S.G. Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and For
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be the son or daughter of a small or marginal farmer, agricultural laborer, or mandi worker, or their dependent. 1. The applicant’s total annual family income must not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
